lastCompletedStory.title: Clean remaining unused locals/params/types in test/**

nextStoryContext: The full flag-on probe (`bunx tsc --noEmit --noUnusedLocals --noUnusedParameters`) now reports ZERO violations project-wide (verified after this story's edits, exit 0, no output). This closes out the ~26 remaining test/** violations from US-003's notes: dead type-only imports removed (ApplyMergeModeOptions, WriteDomainDocsOnMainOutcome, GenUuid, RunTriageOptions), dead node:fs imports removed (mkdirSync in models.test.ts, existsSync in plan-target-invalid-sidecar.test.ts, mkdtempSync+tmpdir pair in retry-pid.test.ts), dead helpers removed (NOOP_SPAWN, failResult), write-only locals removed (bootstrapCalled in issue.test.ts, tick alias of flushInk in dashboard.test.ts detail-view describe block, sub local in alloc.test.ts), a for-of destructure slot dropped ([, model] instead of [phase, model]), a fixture destructure trimmed ([maj] instead of [maj, min] in renamed-derived-probe.ts, verified check-version-skips.test.ts assertions key off runtimeIsModern not min), and required-signature callback params underscore-prefixed (cmd/options/args across attach-hint, bootstrap-wait, journal-append, on-main-multi x3, setup.test.ts, triage.test.ts x2, alloc.test.ts's map callback). Zero new @ts-ignore/@ts-expect-error introduced (verified via git diff grep). Full check:all spine green (4529 pass / 0 fail, typecheck/lint/file-size/debt-markers/version-skips/coverage/dead-code/dup/ci-parity/agents-md all ok). Flags stay OFF in tsconfig.json for this story -- US-004 is the story that flips noUnusedLocals/noUnusedParameters to true in tsconfig.json now that the probe is clean project-wide. US-004 should start by re-running the exact probe command as a pre-flip sanity check before editing tsconfig.json, since time may have passed and new code could have landed.
